cause.coefficient_discrepancy: Outputs generated from different versions of the harmonized input were mixed in the manuscript.
cause.historical_replication: All eight archived informal coefficients were reproduced from the historical input within 1e-7.
cause.inference_discrepancy: Some manually assembled linear contrasts used normal critical values while standard coefficient tables used cluster-based Student t inference.

correction.contrast_tests: Two-sided Student t with model-specific cluster degrees of freedom.
correction.normalizations: Solo, 101+, and 11-19 reference categories are computed from each model's coefficient vector and full covariance matrix.
correction.text: Updated benchmark coefficients, formality premiums, annual significance statements, confidence intervals, and inference explanations. Clarified that the 2025 informal endpoint profile reaches its highest point estimate at 11-19 workers, not 101+.

unchanged: Preferred coefficients and standard errors, including all those used by the income scenarios.
